# Kits

<!-- generated by ./spro catalog from kit.xml, kit.toml, profiles/ and the kit manifests -->

Targets: `linux` — Linux controller, `sim` — ESP32 firmware code on a PC, `esp32` — ESP32-S3.
Profiles: `full`, `lite`, `pro`. A kit outside a profile is added with `--add kit`.
Native ids: `registry/native-ids.md`.

## Packs

Kit sets for a trade, added to a profile with `--pack NAME` (rules of the pro kits: [pro-kits.md](pro-kits.md)).

| Pack | Kits | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `control` | [sproBase](#sprobase), [sproSignal](#sprosignal), [sproControl](#sprocontrol) | Measurement and control: 4-20 mA, RTD/NTC, filters, validation, pro PID, sequences, stages, 3-point actuators |
| `energy` | [sproBase](#sprobase), [sproSignal](#sprosignal), [sproAlarm](#sproalarm), [sproSched](#sprosched), [sproEnergy](#sproenergy) | Energy: meters with tariff zones and day/month totals, pulse counting, calculated heat meter, demand with load shedding, automatic transfer switch with generator |
| `heat` | [sproBase](#sprobase), [sproSignal](#sprosignal), [sproControl](#sprocontrol), [sproEquip](#sproequip), [sproAlarm](#sproalarm), [sproSched](#sprosched), [sproHeat](#sproheat), [sproHeatSt](#sproheatst) | Heating substations: outdoor-reset curve, heating circuit with return limit and frost protection, hot water with disinfection and priority, make-up; pumps, schedules, alarms; substation configurator |
| `hvac` | [sproBase](#sprobase), [sproSignal](#sprosignal), [sproControl](#sprocontrol), [sproEquip](#sproequip), [sproAlarm](#sproalarm), [sproSched](#sprosched), [sproHvac](#sprohvac), [sproAhu](#sproahu), [sproHumid](#sprohumid) | Air handling: schedules and holidays, optimum start, season, AHU sequencer, supply temperature cascade, water heater with frost protection, electric heater, heat recovery, fans, humidity (psychrometrics, humidifier, dehumidification, enthalpy economizer) |
| `pumps` | [sproBase](#sprobase), [sproSignal](#sprosignal), [sproControl](#sprocontrol), [sproEquip](#sproequip), [sproAlarm](#sproalarm), [sproPumpSt](#spropumpst) | Pumps and equipment: motor protections, duty/standby and lead/lag rotation, pump cascade with sleep, alarms and trips, pump station configurator |
